hooks.command: if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts" ]; then if ! bun "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts"; then echo "BLOCKED: .claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts failed to run, so the command is refused rather than run unguarded." >&2; exit 2; fi; else echo "BLOCKED: .claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts not found under this checkout's git root, so the command is refused rather than run unguarded." >&2; exit 2; fi

if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "$root/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
